question: Please decide whether to remove the comparison between lunar crater preservation and Earth’s rain-and-river erosion, or provide an appropriate source supporting that explanation. The article cannot be submitted as fact-checked in its current state.

topic.topic: Why the Moon Has So Many Craters—and Why They Stay
topic.angle: Explain how impacts formed lunar craters and why, without substantial weather or flowing water to wear them down, many remain visible for immense spans of time. Distinguish this slow preservation from the idea that the Moon is geologically inactive in every respect.
